old: A demo server attached to a demo indexer, with a group list that only covers what members ask for and a stated risk that content disappears when the beta misbehaves. On 2026-11-03 neither the website (an HTTP GET timed out) nor the NNTP port of news.usenetmax.com (a TCP connect timed out) answered, while DNS for both names resolves and a Wayback Machine copy of the home page dated 2026-06-27 shows the offer. Liveness is unconfirmed: the page text that reads today is an index copy.
